usedFor: Shopify supplies the shopper's phone number and 1Lookup checks whether it is any good. An “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify runs “Validate Phone Number” in 1Lookup, which returns line type, carrier, reachability and DNC flags.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Validate Phone Number” in 1Lookup
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout is the one trigger that carries a phone number. “Validate Phone Number” returns a recommended action, so you know which shoppers are worth a text before you send one.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it checks on a schedule, and a shopper who left only an email gives “Validate Phone Number” nothing to check.
